fin.headline: Prediction markets hit $24B monthly volume; insider trading scandals mount
fin.body: Kalshi and Polymarket combined global trading volume surged from $4.5B (Sept 2025) to ~$24B (Apr 2026), with Kalshi now carrying >$1.5B annualised revenue and a $22B valuation. Insider trading is a structural integrity problem: a US Army soldier faces trial for $400k in Polymarket profits from classified Maduro-capture intel, a Google employee was charged for betting on internal search data, and suspicious Iran war wagers from new accounts netted $1M. Kalshi is moving to require employer disclosure for sensitive trades, but Democratic senators are pushing the CFTC to restrict bet categories outright.
